input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, USA, excluding conflict of laws provisions and excluding the 1980 United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Any disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with the then-current commercial arbitration rules of the American Arbitration Association ("RULES"). The arbitration shall be conducted by one (1) arbitrator appointed in accordance with the Rules in San Francisco County, California.
input.rationale: Section 14.3 selects California law, which is acceptable at the fallback level, but the dispute forum is mandatory single-arbitrator AAA arbitration in San Francisco rather than the corresponding California courts, so the fallback forum element fails on a material term (the arbitration seat is domestic, so this is not walk-away territory). We keep California law untouched and replace only the arbitration mechanic with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in San Francisco County, and conform the Section 12.2 escrow cross-reference so it no longer refers to arbitration under Section 14.3.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We accept California governing law, but our playbook requires a court forum rather than binding arbitration, so we have replaced the AAA arbitration mechanic with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in San Francisco County and conformed the Section 12.2 cross-reference.

ops.oldText: Any disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration in accordance with the then-current commercial arbitration rules of the American Arbitration Association ("RULES"). The arbitration shall be conducted by one (1) arbitrator appointed in accordance with the Rules in San Francisco County, California. A judgment upon the award may be entered in any court having jurisdiction of the parties, including without limitation the courts in San Francisco, California. The non-prevailing party in the arbitration shall pay all fees and charges of the American Arbitration Association; each party, however, shall be responsible for the payment of all fees and expenses connected with the presentation of its respective case.
ops.newText: Any disputes arising out of this Agreement shall be resolved exclusively in the state and federal courts located in San Francisco County, California, and each party consents to the exclusive jurisdiction of such courts.

ops.oldText: the matter shall be referred to arbitration in the manner provided in Section 14.3
ops.newText: the matter shall be referred to the courts specified in Section 14.3
